name: activity-list-empty
goal: Show a meaningful empty activity list and capture only the component states

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: An empty Activity List has no visible presentation, while the standalone state screenshot includes surrounding fixture headings instead of the component.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing catalog had no empty variant and the standalone state test supplied its own empty message and captured the full fixture. The shared tests now require a component-owned empty message and capture the component bounds.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The committed empty catalog assertion failed on harbor-mbp-2 because the component has no empty status message.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Render an accessible empty message from the supplied item name and document the propagated row-snippet error.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged empty catalog assertion passed on harbor-mbp-2 at the separate component repair commit.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
